run_validation_evaluation: run the evaluate.py script to compute validation loss on a trained language model using torchrun
create_distributed_dataloader: create a DistributedDataLoader instance to load tokenized data shards across multiple GPU processes
load_data_shard: load all tokens from a binary data shard file using the _load_data_shard function
peek_data_shard: peek at a binary data shard header to get the token count using _peek_data_shard
review_hyperparameters: review the Hyperparameters dataclass to configure batch size, sequence length, and validation tokens
